title: Table view
description: Shows a table result row by row; the default view of result tables

title: Rich text
description: Shows a Markdown text result (headings, lists, tables, quotes, code)

title: Record
description: A set of key-value properties; suits a conclusion card or a set of key metrics

title: Image / media / file
description: Shows an image (SVG/PNG/JPEG); a video, sound or PDF by its poster (playing videos and sounds in place); any other file as an icon

title: Bar chart
description: Sums a numeric field by a grouping field; suits comparing categories (regions, products, customers)
config_summary: value=numeric field name, by=grouping field name

title: Line chart
description: Draws a numeric line ordered by the x field; suits time series (months, dates) and trends
config_summary: x=x-axis field name, y=numeric field name

title: Metric card
description: One aggregate number (sum / average / count / maximum)
